method: SEC Form 13F holdings from bulk data sets and individual EDGAR filings, including late amendments. Long shares only, no options. Managers that filed for both quarters, except those whose holdings table is incomplete (rows below 90% of the entries declared). Shares as filed for the quarter; the earlier quarter is put on the same basis for splits in between. Value = shares x the median price per share the filers report. A position whose value per share is more than 2x from that price (in dollars or thousands), or whose shares were restated for a split after the quarter, is left out of both quarters and counted. Facts, not a signal.
